Niddhūmake.g: niddhūme nijjhāle aggimhi pakkamaṁsaṁ sādhupakkaṁ nāma hoti.

nidhī.g: maṅgalahatthiṁ ārohanakāle suvaṇṇanisseṇiyā attharaṇaṭṭhānato nidhiṁ nīharāpesi.
